verdict.reason: Not preview-eligible. (1) The name and the karazin.ua domain match across many results, but all of them are on the institution's own subdomains. No independent government or third-party result linked the name to the domain, so the 'two independent results' test fails. (2) No government or authority result lists the institution or its 222 Medicine programme as a registered, licensed or accredited entity. A NAQA expert-register PDF mentions the Ukrainian official name only as an expert's affiliation. The Study in Ukraine field-22 list reportedly has no Karazin 222 entry (tool paraphrase), and EDEBO/MON listings were not returned. A third-party aggregator result (vstup.osvita.ua, 2025, Kharkiv region) appeared, but its content was not shown. (3) Holds as a lead: official-domain pages show foreign students in Medicine taught in English. These are the legacy undated 'About the School' page (3,700+ students from 40 countries; Ukrainian, Russian, English) and 2022 School news/report items about English-language training of foreign citizens. None is a dated 2026 confirmation of Medicine intake for foreigners. (4) There is an unresolved wartime/operating question. A 2022 School report mentions an 'Ivano-Frankivsk branch' for English-track foreign students; this could not be reproduced or pinned down. No dated official or government result states where and how 222 Medicine teaching currently takes place (Kharkiv in-person, a branch, or distance). Next steps: check the EDEBO register for the institution and its 222 offer, the NAQA accreditation register for Karazin 222 Medicine, and a dated official statement on teaching location and format for 2026/27.
